The parse error came from the `{WR}`-style parameter placeholders, which the evaluator doesn't accept. This netlist uses literal sizes everywhere. The values come from hand calculations only and have not been simulated.

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- bias: diode-connected reference sinks IREF = 10 uA ----
Mref ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=10u L=1u
* first-stage tail (1x -> 10 uA)
Mt   tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=10u L=1u
* second-stage current sink (3.5x -> 35 uA)
M7   vout  ibias vss vss nfet W=35u L=1u
* ---- stage 1: NMOS diff pair + PMOS mirror load ----
* vinp drives the output side of the mirror (x1), so x1 is inverting w.r.t. vinp;
* the PMOS CS stage inverts again -> vout non-inverting w.r.t. vinp
M1 xd   vinn tail vss nfet W=24u L=1u
M2 x1   vinp tail vss nfet W=24u L=1u
M3 xd   xd   vdd vdd pfet W=8u  L=0.5u
M4 x1   xd   vdd vdd pfet W=8u  L=0.5u
* ---- stage 2: PMOS common source (W6/W3 = 7 = 35uA/5uA -> no systematic offset) ----
M6 vout x1 vdd vdd pfet W=56u L=0.5u
* ---- Miller compensation with zero-nulling resistor ----
Rz x1 cz 6k
Cc cz vout 0.75p
.ends dut
```
